evidence: src/infrastructure/InMemoryOrderRepository.ts: class InMemoryOrderRepository implements OrderRepository, so it is an adapter for a domain port, which is an infrastructure job
save() and findById() only write to and read from the private Map store, which is persistence work
findByState() is a simple equality filter on order.state used as a query. It does not enforce any business rule
parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file is an infrastructure adapter. It implements the domain port OrderRepository and stores orders in an in-memory Map. Its only jobs are persistence and lookup: save, findById, findByState and findAll. findByState filters orders by matching their state. That is a plain query on the stored data, not a business rule or state-transition logic. The file has no domain invariants, no orchestration of use cases and no presentation logic, so everything it does belongs to the infrastructure layer.
